mapper.select: SELECT * FROM order_submit_trace WHERE trace_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE order_submit_trace SET status='PROCESSING',processing_expires_at=#{deadline,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP},next_check_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), version=version+1,accepted_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE trace_id=#{id} AND status='INIT' AND version=#{version} AND expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)

UPDATE order_submit_trace SET status=#{status},failure_code=#{code},failure_reason=#{reason},reserve_status=#{reserve}, version=version+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),finished_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE trace_id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status IN ('INIT','PROCESSING')
mapper.select: SELECT trace_id FROM order_submit_trace WHERE next_check_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND ((status='INIT' AND (expires_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) OR reserve_status='RESERVING')) OR (status='PROCESSING' AND mode='ASYNC') OR reserve_status IN ('CONFIRM_PENDING','RELEASE_PENDING')) ORDER BY next_check_at,trace_id LIMIT 50
mapper.update: UPDATE order_submit_trace SET next_check_at=#{next} WHERE trace_id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS pending,MIN(accepted_at) AS oldest FROM order_submit_trace WHERE status='PROCESSING'

SELECT 'processing' AS stage, COUNT(*) AS pending, MIN(accepted_at) AS oldest FROM order_submit_trace WHERE mode='ASYNC' AND status='PROCESSING' UNION ALL SELECT 'confirm_pending' AS stage, COUNT(*) AS pending, MIN(finished_at) AS oldest FROM order_submit_trace WHERE mode='ASYNC' AND status='SUCCESS' AND reserve_status='CONFIRM_PENDING' UNION ALL SELECT 'release_pending' AS stage, COUNT(*) AS pending, MIN(finished_at) AS oldest FROM order_submit_trace WHERE mode='ASYNC' AND status IN ('FAILED','EXPIRED') AND reserve_status='RELEASE_PENDING'
